review.model_version_note: Exact serving model revision was not exposed/recorded for this conversational review.
review.basis: Read all 20 unique chunk texts and compare with adjacent normalized source text; assess self-contained meaning using the unchanged 0/1/2 rubric. No scores derived from Hit@1/Hit@3 or punctuation rules.
review.independent_review_scope: Independent agent received only opaque sample IDs, chunk text, page/offsets and adjacent source context; strategy labels and retrieval metrics were omitted.
review.primary_reviewer_prior_exposure: Primary assistant had previously seen overall retrieval results; the isolated review did not receive them.
review.repeated_records: B and C use identical physical chunks, so their labels/reasons are shared; 30 records represent 20 unique chunks, not 30 independent observations.
review.calibration_note: A chunk with interpretable content but missing context is 1; a boundary cut alone does not force 0. Missing attribution/citation alone does not prevent 2 if the substantive idea is complete.

borderline_case.reason: The regional list/figure text lacks its main relation, but the poverty-line and cross-year comparability note is still interpretable; 0 would overstate total unintelligibility.
